tier1.text: Costal cartilages join most ribs to the sternum, or breastbone, at the front of the chest. Each costal cartilage is attached to the front end of a rib. Costal cartilage is made of hyaline cartilage, a smooth tissue that is strong and flexible. The springiness of costal cartilage lets the rib cage expand when you breathe.

quotes.quote: The surface of hyaline cartilage is smooth. Both strong and flexible, it is found in the rib cage and nose and covers bones where they meet to form moveable joints.

quotes.quote: The cartilage positioned between the anterior end of the rib and the sternum. Its elasticity allows the ribcage to expand while breathing.
